meanings.Enchanter: Strengthens allies with heals, shields and buffs.
meanings.Catcher: Locks down enemies who walk into their traps and hooks.
meanings.Juggernaut: Slow, hard to kill and hits hard up close.
meanings.Diver: Jumps onto a target and stays on them.
meanings.Burst: Deletes one target with a quick combo.
meanings.Battlemage: Stays in the fight and deals damage over time.
meanings.Marksman: Steady damage from range with basic attacks.
meanings.Assassin: Gets in, kills a squishy target, gets out.
meanings.Skirmisher: Wins long close-range fights with strong duelling.
meanings.Vanguard: Starts fights by diving in with crowd control.
meanings.Warden: Protects allies and peels for them.
meanings.Poke: Damages from long range (1,000 or more) before a fight starts.
meanings.Engage: Starts fights by jumping in with crowd control.
meanings.Crowd control: Has two or more abilities that stun, root, knock up, charm, taunt, pull or the like.
